title: "wrapped fixture: a Typst percent width whose default also fills the text with its gap"
filters:
  - wrapped
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    fig-format: png
wrapped:
  width: 80%
---

![A wrapped figure.](plot.png){#fig-gap-default .wrap-right width="75%" wrap-gap="30%"}

The width of 75% with a 30% gap fills the text, and so does the document default of 80% with that gap, so the render prints a warning that names the built-in 40%.
